hero.title: A global technology company built on digital trust.
hero.lead: Since 2004 SAVIS has designed, delivered and operated the identity, cryptography and platforms that governments, banks and enterprises depend on.

blocks.title: Twenty-two years of building digital trust.
blocks.lead: SAVIS started in Hanoi in 2004. Over 22 years we have built core technology in digital identity, trust services, cybersecurity, open finance and AI platforms, and delivered it to public institutions and financial services. Today we serve customers from ten offices on four continents.

cards.text: Build the trusted digital infrastructure that lets nations and enterprises serve people securely.
A global technology company, trusted wherever digital interactions happen.
